prices.note: Like-for-like item: men's short-sleeve T-shirts. Read with curl (StylodexBot UA) from the Guys > Tees listing three ways: default sort (sz=1000 returned 200), srule=sortingPriceLowToHigh&sz=200 and srule=sortingPriceHighToLow&sz=200, so both ends of the range are covered: 588 unique products, 547 short-sleeve T-shirts with no strike-through price. Excluded: 10 with a crossed-out list price, and long-sleeve, twofer, hoodie, tank and crop items. Prices are the tile price (every tile carries a 'From' label, so a few sizes may cost more; not checked). Min: InuYasha Yellow & White T-Shirt $12.99 (next: Shaka Wear 7.5 Oz. Heavyweight T-Shirt $15.90); max: WWE John Cena Wrestlemania 23 Garment-Dyed T-Shirt $50.90 (Comfort Colors heavyweight tee, 100% cotton) and Bad Bunny DTMF Casita World Tour Black T-Shirt $50.00.

Girls > Tops listing read with curl (StylodexBot UA) sorted both ways (srule=sortingPriceLowToHigh&sz=200 and sortingPriceHighToLow&sz=200), so both ends are covered; tiles showing a struck list price excluded, as are belts, kimonos, dusters and jackets. notes: 2026-10-29 (zumiez page run): homepage title 'Hot Topic | The Pop-Culture Merch & Clothing Store'; nav Pop Culture, Halloween, Holiday, New, Girls, Plus, Guys, Tees, Backpacks & Bags, Accessories; banner 'Free Shipping With $75 Purchase*'. known_for from the title.

Shipping page: 'Hottopic.com ships to all 50 states, APO/FPO addresses, U.S. territories and possessions and over 150+ countries' (countries not named, so ships_to records the US only); Standard 3–8 business days $7.99 on the $0.01–$49.99 and $50–$99.99 bands; product page: 'Free delivery over $75, exclusions apply'; pre-order merch carries a $1.99 per-item surcharge to home addresses; Hawaii, Alaska, APO/FPO excluded from the sitewide offer.

Returns page: 'Refunds are valid within 30 days of purchase', with exceptions (beauty, body jewelry final sale; bags and collectibles 7 days; defective items 90 days); return to a Hot Topic store or by mail.
Size filter on Guys > Tees: XS, S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL, 4XL, 5XL and tall LT, XLT, 2XLT, 3XLT, 4XLT. size_range detail: XS–5XL; tall LT–4XLT.

Wikipedia (Hot Topic): founded October 1989 in Montclair, California by Orv Madden; HQ City of Industry, California; Sycamore Partners bought it in 2013; on August 7, 2026 Spencer Spirit Holdings announced it would acquire Hot Topic from Sycamore (pending), so parent_company is left empty; 675 locations (April 2020). Store locator (hottopic.com/stores) loads by script, so us_stores is not set.

Wikipedia (Hot Topic) also: stores target 'counterculture-related clothing and accessories' and licensed music; the current selection is mostly licensed video game merchandise, internet memes, anime, manga and Japanese film merchandise. Shipping page: 'There is an additional $1.99 surcharge per item on pre-order merch shipped to home addresses. This surcharge is waived entirely if the Ship To Store option is selected.'

2026-10-29 (spencers page run, C graphic-tees): graphic-tees price from the all-tees listing (see price note). Its tees are licensed pop-culture, music and anime tees, so the whole listing counts as graphic tees except blank basics.
